name: React CI Pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test -- --coverage
      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build

name: CD Pipeline
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Select environment'
        required: true
        default: 'production'

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build

      - name: Deploy to AKS
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f k8s/

      - name: Run Post Deployment Tests
        run: npm run test:e2e

      - name: Notify on Success
        if: success()
        run: echo "Deployment to ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }} successful"
